reference: Yee et al. 2000 case-pool entry (<6 % tolerance); the target here is the analytic vortex, and the mechanism question is internal to this repository

records.metric: volume-Gauss relative L2 (committed C1 metric) + Helmholtz split

M1_signature.criterion: base_t2: solenoidal fraction of the velocity error > 0.5 AND grid band (wavelength < 2 cells) carries > 0.5 of its energy (when measured) AND spectral peak wavelength < 2 cells AND u/rho error ratio > 5x the t=1 value

M2_dealias.criterion: max_rel(q=6, t=2) / max_rel(q=4, t=2) < 0.5 and the same at t=5 (quadrature is what limits the committed numbers)

M3_cfl.criterion: max_rel(cfl=0.1, t=2) / max_rel(cfl=0.2, t=2) in [0.7, 1.4] (the growth is not a time-step artefact)
